{{Top|leg}}
A '''lockbox''' was a secure container that could hold valuable items. A lockbox containing a [[Hapan]] [[Gun of Command]] was the target of a [[Heist on the Song of the Clouds|heist]] by [[Cecil Noone]] and his [[Cecil Noone's crew|crew]] of [[Thief/Legends|thieves]]. They infiltrated the [[Ithorian Herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]'' to obtain the lockbox for [[Guttu]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>
